tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Leibniz rule for the bracket]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-2

1. ch0:5.3For smooth vector fields $X,Y$ and smooth functions $f,g$ one has $[fX,gY]=fg[X,Y]+fX(g)Y-gY(f)X$, where $X(g)=dg_p(X_p)$ denotes the derivative of $g$ along $X$.
Proof

\sketch

Expand the bracket by the first-slot Leibniz identity $[fX,W]=f[X,W]-W(f)X$ with $W=gY$, then the second-slot Leibniz identity $[X,gY]=g[X,Y]+X(g)Y$; combining and using linearity of the differential $dg_p$ gives $[fX,gY]=fg[X,Y]+fX(g)Y-gY(f)X$.

□
